maddeler.e:
يلتحقون (form VIII)
# يَلْتَحِقُونَ (yaltaḥiqūna) /jal.ta.ħi.quː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
# يُلْتَحَقُونَ (yultaḥaqūna) /jul.ta.ħa.quː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
